# Third-party sources

`stb_image.h` — stb_image v2.29 by Sean Barrett, public domain / MIT
(dual-licensed, see the end of the file). Copied unmodified from the Gentoo
`media-libs/stb` package (`/usr/include/stb/stb_image.h`, SHA-256
c54b15a689e6a1f32c75e2ec23afa442e3e0e37e894b73c1974d08679b20dd5c); upstream
https://github.com/nothings/stb. Used by `src/images.cpp` for PNG/JPEG
decoding of instance icons, catalog icons, world icons and screenshots.
